REF: 2686L: CONSTITUTION STREET

 

Fantastic, 2 bedroom flat located on Constitution Street, very close to the renowned Shore area. This is a much sought after location with a variety of famous restaurants, popular bars and boutiques on offer. With a tram stop immediately outside and excellent bus links also available, there is easy access to the whole city. Ocean Terminal and a 24 hour supermarket are also just a short journey away. This flat would be ideal for professionals or mature students looking for a spacious, upmarket property in a very vibrant area of the city.

 

The 2nd floor property is part of an attractive, modern build development and is available FURNISHED, comprising:

~Contemporary, open-plan, lounge/kitchen/diner with laminate flooring, bright outlook and desirable corner sofa

~Kitchen is well-equipped with range of modern appliances, stylish, glossy units and counter-top lighting

~Desirable master bedroom with laminate flooring, built-in wardrobe storage and private en suite shower room

~Second double bedroom, generously sized, also with laminate flooring

~Family bathroom with tiled splashback and three-piece suite including shower over bath

~Entrance hallway providing access to all rooms and with further storage space

~Private, allocated parking space

~Communal garden access

~Communal rooftop courtyard

~Factoring service

~Electric storage heating

~Double glazing

~Lift access

~Secure entry

~Sorry, no pets

~Total floor area = 66m²

~Council tax: band D

~EPC rating: B

~Landlord registration: Pending

~LARN1806025

 

Available: 18th September 2026

 

Rent: £1,350pcm

Deposit: £1,350

 

Please note the photographs shown within this advertisement may have been taken whilst a tenancy was active in the property and as a result you should not rely only on these as an accurate representation of furnishings and items included in the agreement. A full list of which items are included in the property is available upon request from our office, based on a previous tenancy. A viewing is therefore required in order to ensure you have an accurate understanding and knowledge of the condition and contents of the property.
